contract-count-per-currency.sparql.title: Contract count per currency
contract-count-per-currency.sparql.template:
# Retrieves the count of contracts per currency for a specific date range.
# Returns: contract currency and the number of contracts, ordered by highest count.
# Change the date range as per your requirements.

PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX epo: <http://data.europa.eu/a4g/ontology#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?contractCurrency (COUNT(DISTINCT ?tender) AS ?numberOfContracts)
WHERE {
  FILTER (?contractConclusionDate >= {{contractConclusionDateStart}} &&
          ?contractConclusionDate <= {{contractConclusionDateEnd}})

  GRAPH ?g {
    ?contract a epo:Contract ;
              epo:hasContractConclusionDate ?contractConclusionDate ;
              epo:includesTender ?tender .

    ?tender epo:hasFinancialOfferValue ?offerValue .

    ?offerValue epo:hasCurrency ?contractCurrencyURI .
  }

  ?contractCurrencyURI dc:identifier ?contractCurrency .
}
GROUP BY ?contractCurrency
ORDER BY DESC(?numberOfContracts)

named-graphs-per-period.sparql.title: Named graphs published on a specified period
named-graphs-per-period.sparql.template:
# Retrieve named graphs (notice metadata) published during a specific period.
# Uses CDM (Common Data Model) metadata to find notice graphs and constructs
# links to the TED website and XML source.
# Returns: date, journal number, METS graph, notice graph, TED URL, and XML URL.
# Change the date range below to adjust the period.

PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?date ?journalNumber ?metsNamedGraph ?noticeNamedGraph ?accessUrl ?xmlSource

WHERE {

  # Date range filter (uses dateTime, not date)
  FILTER (?date >= "{{startDate}}T00:00:00"^^xsd:dateTime &&
          ?date <= "{{endDate}}T23:59:59"^^xsd:dateTime)

  GRAPH ?metsNamedGraph {
    # Get procurement metadata from CDM
    ?s a cdm:procurement_public .
    ?s cdm:procurement_public_number_document_in_official-journal ?journalNumber .
    ?s cdm:work_date_document ?date .

    # Construct the notice named graph URI
    BIND(IRI(CONCAT(
               "http://data.europa.eu/a4g/resource/",
               STR(YEAR(xsd:dateTime(?date))), "/",
               ?journalNumber, "_",
               STR(YEAR(xsd:dateTime(?date)))
            )) AS ?noticeNamedGraph)

    # Construct the TED website URL for this notice
    BIND(IRI(CONCAT(
               "https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/-/detail/",
               ?journalNumber, "-",
               STR(YEAR(xsd:dateTime(?date)))
            )) AS ?accessUrl)

    # Construct the XML source URL for this notice
    BIND(IRI(CONCAT(
               "https://ted.europa.eu/en/notice/",
               ?journalNumber, "-",
               STR(YEAR(xsd:dateTime(?date))), "/xml"
            )) AS ?xmlSource)
  }
}
